name: Vraska
aliases: a woman with hair like twisting vines
description: Vraska is a gorgon planeswalker and assassin of the Ochran from Ravnica who petrifies enemies with her gaze, rose to lead the Golgari, and is Jace's beloved.

timeline.summary: Vraska enters, and Javy warns Relov not to look at her face as the gorgon sweeps into the room.
timeline.quote: "Don't look her in the face," Javy ordered Relov as the gorgon swept into the room.

citation.work: The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2
citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Relov she was cast into a dark tomb just before a guard would have killed her, and resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.
timeline.quote: I resolved that all should receive the death they deserve.

citation.work: The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2
citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Vraska lets Javy choose Relov's death, and Javy names inaction.
timeline.quote: Javy didn't hesitate. "Inaction," she said.

citation.work: The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2
citation.text: "The Shadows of Prahv, Part 2" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2012.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals herself as a gorgon and planeswalker and says she wants Jace to prove he will be an ally of Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Before him was a gorgon.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Jace deduces that Vraska wants to rule Ravnica, and she declares she is ready to kill him; the Jace she looks at is only an illusion.
timeline.quote: Instead of turning to stone, Jace melted away into nothingness.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: The real Jace emerges and has Vraska send her four assassins away; he deduces she wants to control him as Guildpact.
timeline.quote: So you want to leave me in the office of the Guildpact, and manipulate me.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Vraska threatens Jace's allies and mentions Garruk Wildspeaker, hinting that something has happened to him, and tells Jace he is a plague.
timeline.quote: You're a plague, Beleren. A scourge to all those you claim to protect.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Vraska strangles Jace with her tendrils; he reads her mind and conjures illusions of himself that attack her.
timeline.quote: Jace felt the gorgon's grip loosen as he sent image after image of himself at her.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies the illusions, which become a cage around her, and the statues speak in Jace's voice and trick her into explaining her plan to take over Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Then, one by one, I will assassinate the guild leaders.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: The statues reveal that Vraska's words have been broadcast to the guild leaders gathered at Sunhome.
timeline.quote: Your statements have been broadcast to all those who've attended.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Vraska crushes what she thinks is Jace's neck but it is her own petrified assassin; the statues close in and she blasts them away and planeswalks off.
timeline.quote: Then she took a breath, closed her eyes, and planeswalked away.

citation.work: The Gorgon and the Guildpact
citation.text: "The Gorgon and the Guildpact" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2014.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

citation.work: In This Very Arena
citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek and Vraska share tea and talk of leadership and pride.
timeline.quote: If I am to be met with disrespect, then I must first love myself with a fierceness no fool can take away.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Mazirek recalls meeting Vraska while consulting the Ochran assassins, and their friendship since.
timeline.quote: Mazirek trusted Vraska with his life.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: In a memory, Mazirek rages that Jarad has cut the kraul's food and ignored them, and Vraska suggests change without bloodshed.
timeline.quote: There are plenty of ways to enact change without shedding blood.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The coffins open and the undead rise of their own accord, as Vraska had told him they would.
timeline.quote: the undead began to rise of their own accord, just as Vraska had told him they would.

citation.work: Pride of the Kraul
citation.text: "Pride of the Kraul" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The ship the Belligerent finds Jace; its gorgon captain, Vraska, threatens him, then sees the state he is in and recognizes him by name.
timeline.quote: Jace, what the hell happened to you?

citation.work: Jace, Alone
citation.text: "Jace, Alone" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds an enchanted invitation from a dragon in her book and planeswalks to the Meditation Plane.
timeline.quote: she planeswalked through a dark slice in the air.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas hires Vraska, reading her mind and offering to make her Guildmaster of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: I can make you Guildmaster of the Golgari, Vraska.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas tasks Vraska with retrieving an item from the Golden City of Orazca on Ixalan, to be summoned by an associate.
timeline.quote: Retrieve the item that is there, summon my associate to transport it

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska accepts, and Bolas bars her from double-crossing him.
timeline.quote: I accept your terms,

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas gives Vraska the thaumatic compass and implants a spell to call his associate and knowledge of sailing.
timeline.quote: It is the thaumatic compass,

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
timeline.quote: Set course due south,

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
timeline.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace tells Vraska he does not remember anything before waking on an island, and she concludes it is not an illusion.
timeline.quote: I don't remember anything from before I woke up on the first island.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides not to kill the harmless Jace and tells him he can stay until the next harbor.
timeline.quote: We'll prepare a hammock for you in the forecastle,

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace accidentally touches Vraska, who flinches because she has not been touched in years.
timeline.quote: She had not physically touched anyone in years.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
timeline.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
timeline.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
timeline.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska invites Jace to stay with her crew, and he accepts.
timeline.quote: I would love to.

citation.work: The Talented Captain Vraska
citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The soldier reveals that two pirate captains and a sun champion's vision are converging on Orazca.
timeline.quote: Forces are converging on your Golden City,

citation.work: The Shapers
citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The Belligerent lands at High and Dry, where the crew disembarks for revelry.
timeline.quote: the crew landed at High and Dry with no need for expensive supplies.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Malcolm takes Jace and Vraska to the Boatswain's Rear for a private briefing.
timeline.quote: He opened the door (an old galley table with a knife still stuck in it)

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Lord Nicolas's contract and the compass, naming Orazca as their target; a River Herald merfolk protests silently.
timeline.quote: The thaumatic compass is enchanted to find a place of power: the forgotten city known as Orazca.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace he is something else entirely.
timeline.quote: You're something else entirely.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace asks if he can read minds, and Vraska confirms telepathically; he learns to silence the voices.
timeline.quote: Yeah, you can.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace about Ravnica, and he conjures an illusion of the snowy city, which she admires with homesickness.
timeline.quote: Yes. This is Ravnica.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace half-remembers a winged lion with a man's face and worries about the minds he may have broken.
timeline.quote: I wonder how many minds I have broken before,

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska tells Jace of the Azorius's mass arrest of Golgari and her brutal imprisonment, her escape and her wish to lead the Golgari.
timeline.quote: They assumed I was Golgari because I was a gorgon, and they arrested me too.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace encourages Vraska that she is meant to be a great leader, and each realizes neither wants to hurt the other.
timeline.quote: Both of them realized at the exact same moment that neither of them wanted to hurt the other.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
timeline.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

citation.work: Something Else Entirely
citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
timeline.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
timeline.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
timeline.quote: We lost Edgar

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
timeline.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
timeline.quote: kill every vampire you find.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
timeline.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
timeline.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
timeline.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
timeline.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
timeline.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
timeline.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
timeline.quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

citation.work: The Race, Part 1
citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
timeline.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

citation.work: The Race, Part 2
citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

citation.work: The Race, Part 2
